claims.text: Today a plain `git worktree add` passes the guard only from an unguarded placement: git_mutates counts `worktree` only for move and remove, so the add names no resource and decide returns 0; from the main checkout or a protected worktree it is already refused as an unproven git segment.
Today the plugin's create-worktree passes the guard in every placement whatever its flags: unproven() marks it proven and continues before any other check.

Today a `git worktree move` destination is judged only for a guarded or occupied placement; the pass to an unguarded destination is pinned by test_protected_branch_acceptance.py:512-515 in an unlisted temporary repository.

No skill, hook, script, adapter or provider file tells an agent to run a bare `git worktree add` or `move`, or the creator with --parent: execute/SKILL.md:16 forbids the bare add, bug/SKILL.md:67 says no --parent, settle-change/SKILL.md:70 names no flag; the guard's own hints name only `--name`.

Every in-repository `git worktree add` and every hook- or launcher-run creator call runs inside a script process the PreToolUse guard never judges: create-worktree:617-629, worktree-provision-smoke.sh:106, gc-check-smoke.sh:75 and :123, worktree-create.sh:26, afk-move.py:114 (spawned by h2_move.py:165), afk-launch.py:57.

No tracked file outside run records sets AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED or AFK_WORKTREE_FOLDER inline inside a command an agent tool call carries: tests pass both through the subprocess environment, hook-smoke.sh:325 sets the launch flag in the guard's own environment, and prose tells only a human to set the flag at launch.

No existing test drives decide with a `git worktree add` envelope or with a creator call carrying --parent or --dir; the creator tests with --parent run the script directly; so no existing test pins an add or creator pass that the change reverses.

The two tests PRD.md:200 and plan/0006-worktree-guard.md:36 call pins of a plain add passing the guard are test_shell_mutations.py:44 (shell_mutations.resources, no repository list) and test_protected_branch_acceptance.py:1035 (the git backstop, not decide); neither can be reversed for a listed repository, so that acceptance bullet cannot be met as written.

The one existing test whose observed guard verdict flips is test_existing_worktree_outside_root.py:409: a `git worktree move` to <base>/moved-<label> in a listed repository with a sandbox HOME turns from allow to deny for the name and dir twins; the case compares normalised twins, so it stays green.

The guard tests that drive worktree move and creator calls use the real HOME, so after the change those calls read the developer's ~/.afk/config.yaml and repositories.json; temporary repositories are unlisted and pass, but an unreadable list raises PlacementError, which the guard would turn into a refusal inside a work tree unless the rule catches it.
The launch flag returns before decide and before the judge loads; the lavish rule runs first and the flag does not lift it.

refusal() appends the AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED bypass line to every refusal, refuse() and the fault path in main() use it, and git-backstop.py:29 reuses it; a refusal that must carry no bypass line cannot go through these helpers as they are.

hook-smoke.sh:348-365 runs the real guard per provider on `touch changed` in a fresh main checkout with no HOME override and AFK_MOVE_SPAWN unset; for codex (H-2) the refusal calls h2_move.plan, which reads the real ~/.afk through placement.target_for and spawns scripts/afk-move.py detached; the command is not a worktree command, so its verdict does not change.

Already-stale register rows: MANIFEST.md:999 omits readers hooks/precommit-gates.sh:44 and hooks/branch-name-gate.sh:65 of AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED; MANIFEST.md:1003 omits reader hooks/lib/h2_move.py:91 of AFK_WORKTREE_FOLDER.

New question: AFK_WORKTREE_OP=1 stays an agent-settable inline bypass of the git backstop (precommit-gates.sh:44, branch-name-gate.sh:65); the planned refusal names only AFK_WORKTREE_FOLDER and AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED.
SDD.md:130 and VERIFICATION-PLAN.md:375 name /afk:settle-change and /afk:execute as callers of `create-worktree --branch --dir --parent`; the two skill files name no --parent.

placement.py is loaded by path at h2_move.py:83, create-worktree:294-298 and :339-344, and afk-config.py:1023-1024; the guard module by path at remove-worktree.py:449-451 (provider_facts only) and by import in git-backstop.py, main_sync.py, protected-branch-occupancy.py and afk-launch.py.
The guard is registered once per harness as a PreToolUse command: hooks/hooks.json:73 and hooks/hooks.codex.json:73.

No test feeds the guard a `git worktree add`; of the guard-level `git worktree move` tests, only scripts/tests/test_existing_worktree_outside_root.py:409 runs on a listed repository, and its verdict flips from allow to deny on both twins, which its twin comparison absorbs (inferred); scripts/tests/test_protected_branch_acceptance.py:515 stays allowed (unlisted repository) and scripts/tests/test_protected_branch_guard.py:1261, :1265, :1316 are already refused.

No test feeds the guard a command that sets AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED or AFK_WORKTREE_FOLDER inline; every test hit sets them in the guard process environment, which main() reads before decide, so the inline-variable refusal has no test pinning today's pass.

Guard tests that run the plugin creator through the guard pass only --name (scripts/tests/test_protected_branch_guard.py:905, :1491); every --parent or --dir creator call in the tests runs the script directly, outside the guard, so the creator-call refusal is unguarded at the guard level.

The 'two existing tests' that PRD.md:200, ADR-0002:43 and plan 0006:36 say pin a plain worktree add passing the guard are, by this enumeration, the module cases scripts/tests/test_shell_mutations.py:44 and :33, which call sm.resources without a repository list; they stay green if the add parser lands in hooks/lib/worktree_placement_rule.py and cannot be reversed for listed repositories without editing hooks/lib/shell_mutations.py, which plan 0006 does not scope.

Today the guard passes `git worktree add` in a linked worktree on an unprotected branch (no resource: shell_mutations.py:602-603) and refuses it in the main checkout or a protected-branch worktree (not read-only: read_only.py:360-361); a literal `git worktree move` destination is judged only by protected branch and occupant (protected_branch_guard.py:887-890).

Production code runs git worktree add or the creator outside PreToolUse (scripts/create-worktree:617-629, hooks/worktree-create.sh:26, scripts/afk-move.py:114, scripts/afk-launch.py:57); skills tell agents to call the creator with no --parent (skills/afk/bug/SKILL.md:67, skills/afk/execute/SKILL.md:16) or leave the arguments unstated (skills/utils/settle-change/SKILL.md:70); no skill, agent or provider file tells an agent to run git worktree move or to set either variable inline.

In an agent session for a listed repository the creator already refuses a --parent outside <root>/<short name> and a --dir that leaves the folder (scripts/create-worktree:385, :389), so the guard's creator rule moves that refusal ahead of the script.

Documents that go stale: hooks/README.md:109 and AGENTS.md:201 say the guard allows everything outside its three guarded resources, SAFETY.md:23 lists only those resources, and ADR-0014:22 lists the creator call and literal worktree move as allowed in a guarded placement.

AFK_WORKTREE_OP=1, read beside AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED by hooks/precommit-gates.sh:44 and hooks/branch-name-gate.sh:65, stays settable inline by an agent after the planned change; whether it must be refused too is a new question this pass does not answer.

SAFETY.md:41 goes stale for the inline-variable refusal: SDD.md:134 sets no placement condition on it and decide has no early return for a folder outside Git, so an agent's inline AFK_ALLOW_PROTECTED=1 from a folder outside Git is refused; the launch-flag half of the sentence stays true.
